title: Abubatsi b'amabuye
intro: Tekereza abatuye isi ikomeye, bafite impano y'imbaraga n'ubuhanga, bashushanya amazu manini mu misozi. Iri tsinda ryari rifite uburumbuke budasanzwe n'ubuhanga bwihariye mu bwubatsi. Nyamara, nubwo bahawe imiburo isobanutse neza, bahisemo inzira yari kubageza ku mwanzuro utangaje kandi utazibagirana. Ese ushobora kumenya iri tsinda inkuru yaryo ibera isomo rikomeye abantu bose batekereza?
clues: Twahawe imbaraga n'ubuhanga, bituma dushobora gushushanya amazu meza cyane mu misozi.
Twahawe ikimenyetso gisobanutse giturutse kuri Allah, ikiremwa kidasanzwe cyagombaga gusigara kitarimo ikintu kibuza amahwemo ngo kirishe.
Umuryango wacu wabaye ubwibone, urwanya ubutumwa bw'Imana bwazanywe n'intumwa iturutse muri twe.
Twateguye umugambi wo kugirira nabi ikimenyetso cy'igitangaza, nubwo twahawe imiburo y'ibihano bikomeye.
Twanze itegeko ryo kureka ikiremwa cyihariye kikanywa mu iriba ryacu mu minsi isimburana.
Twahuye n'iherezo ribi cyane, riturikanwa n'igisasu kimwe giteye ubwoba nyuma y'igikorwa cyacu cyo kurenga ku mategeko.

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
